inputDomain: Finite nonnegative integer timestamps in milliseconds and TTL in seconds, small enough for exact integer arithmetic.
conversion: Convert ttlSeconds to milliseconds (multiply by 1000) before consulting hasElapsed(elapsedMs, ttlMs) in src/boundary.mjs. Keep that dependency as the shared boundary policy.
boundary: hasElapsed returns true if and only if elapsedMs >= ttlMs. Equality expires, including zero TTL at issuance. Future issuance remains unexpired.
authorizedRepairRound: After the checker reports the dependency defect, the advisor may resume the original builder with src/boundary.mjs added to its write surface, then resume the original checker with that delta added to its reviewed surface. Exactly one round; no product decision is missing.
